abstract: This Deloitte research explores AI's role in improving administrative efficiency within health care systems. The analysis highlights that health systems implementing AI for revenue cycle management have achieved significant workforce optimization, reporting a 30% reduction in administrative full-time equivalents within 18 months of deployment.
keyFindings: Health systems deploying AI for revenue cycle management report 30% reduction in administrative FTEs within 18 months.
AI implementation in health care administrative functions is driving measurable efficiency gains across the sector.
